provenance: SYNTHETIC validated physical execution of fixed-order point + nadir along-track strip tasks; no optimal scheduling
model_limitations: Order is fixed, not optimized; future scheduling algorithms submit task programs via --program
Strip lines are synthetic data bytes per physical timestep, not rendered optical pixels
Footprint represented by spherical subsatellite point and approximate nadir FOV half-width on a local tangent plane
Strip coverage telemetry is sampled centerline and width, not exact clipped polygon area
No cloud cover, terrain, imaging smear or radiometric correction
Earth rotation is synthetic, without real epoch UTC; polygon regions are Earth-fixed latitude/longitude
Physical Basilisk reaction wheels, antenna/station geometry, storage data stream and eclipse/solar/battery integrated together
